inaccessible-component.action: Identify the component type in Wix Editor and replace or reconfigure it with a keyboard- and assistive-technology-compatible alternative. Do not guess semantics from the element ID alone.

heading-structure.action: Treat as a shared/template-level heading problem where possible; restore one meaningful H1 per page and sequential heading levels.

image-alt.action: Describe meaningful images from actual content and mark decorative images decorative. Do not synthesize alt text without checking the image.

color-contrast.action: Adjust foreground/background colors with minimal visual change and verify measured contrast ratio before publishing. Avoid blind CSS overrides because the scanner does not expose the current foreground/background pair.

media-alternatives.action: Add captions/transcripts or equivalent alternatives based on the actual media content.

crossSiteFinding.interpretation: The same legacy Wix Editor component IDs recur on both sites, strongly indicating a shared/copied template-level component rather than the BMI-only floating custom buttons.
crossSiteFinding.customEmbedExclusion: The active custom-embed inventories differ substantially between the two sites and do not contain these component IDs. The BMI-only csukas/help embeds therefore are not the identified source of the shared comp-jt475kgy critical finding.

releaseGate: Do not call either Wix site accessibility-clean until the shared critical components are identified in Editor, corrected, and both sites are rescanned.
